lines.script: I get attached way too much. Someone becomes my friend, and apparently my brain signs a lifetime contract. They were just having a conversation. I'm already planning the reunion.
lines.measured_transcript: I get attached way too much. Someone becomes my friend. And apparently my brain signs a lifetime contract. They were just having a conversation. I'm already planning the reunion.

lines.script: Once, I went to a city with my family, and two of my friends lived there. We hadn't met in two or three years. So obviously, I was excited.
lines.measured_transcript: Once, I went to a city with my family, and two of my friends lived there. We hadn't met in two or three years, so obviously I was excited.

lines.script: I asked both of them if we could meet. In my head, we'd catch up, talk about everything, and forget how long it had been. I'd already imagined the whole day.
lines.measured_transcript: I asked both of them if we could meet. In my head, we'd catch up, talk about everything, and forget how long it had been. I'd already imagined the whole day.

lines.script: Both of them said they were busy. And I just stared at my phone. I came from so far away. You can't take one day off for me? One day?
lines.measured_transcript: Both of them said they were busy, and I just stared at my phone. I came from so far away. You can't take one day off for me? One day?

lines.script: That was what I wanted to say. I know people have work, plans, their own lives. But knowing that didn't magically make it stop hurting. I really wanted to see them.
lines.measured_transcript: That was what I wanted to say. I know people have work, plans, their own lives. But knowing that didn't magically make it stop hurting. I really wanted to see them.

lines.script: I think the part that hurt was realizing I'd been looking forward to something they might not have been thinking about at all. I'd missed them. I wanted to feel missed too.
lines.measured_transcript: I think the part that hurt was realizing I'd been looking forward to something they might not have been thinking about at all. I'd missed them. I wanted to feel missed too.

lines.script: And this wasn't new. Even in school, I'd text my friends all excited, hoping they'd reply with that same energy. I'd have so much to say. Then the reply would feel so small.
lines.measured_transcript: And this wasn't new. Even in school, I'd text my friends all excited, hoping they'd reply with that same energy. I'd have so much to say. Then the reply would feel so small.

lines.script: And suddenly, I'd feel silly for being excited. I'd read my own message again, like the extra excitement was a spelling mistake I could fix. Maybe I should've said less.
lines.measured_transcript: And suddenly, I'd feel silly for being excited. I'd read my own message again. Like the extra excitement was a spelling mistake I could fix. Maybe I should have said less.

lines.script: I get attached to animals like that too. Neeko wasn't just a cat I looked after. I cared about her so much. Even after she found a family, that feeling didn't just switch off.
lines.measured_transcript: I get attached to animals like that too. Neeko wasn't just the cat I looked after. I cared about her so much. Even after she found a family, that feeling didn't just switch off.

lines.script: That's the thing. I remember people. I miss them. I carry little bits of them around, even when life has moved on. Sometimes I wish my brain had a slightly smaller storage plan.
lines.measured_transcript: That's the thing. I remember people. I miss them. I carry little bits of them around, even when life has moved on. Sometimes I wish my brain had a slightly smaller storage plan.

lines.script: I'm still figuring this out. I don't want to become someone who pretends not to care. I just want to stop treating every quiet reply like proof that I matter less.
lines.measured_transcript: I'm still figuring this out. I don't want to become someone who pretends not to care. I just want to stop treating every quiet reply like proof that I matter less.

lines.script: I can miss someone and still put my phone down. I can be excited to see them without putting my whole day on hold. I'll probably always care a lot. I'd like to save a little of that for myself.
